name: B10-0361/2025 (ECR) – Strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on strengthening Moldova’s resilience against Russian hybrid threats and malign interference
part_text:
The European Parliament calls for stronger support for Moldova ahead of its parliamentary elections on 28 September 2025. It condemns Russian interference, including disinformation, cyberattacks, vote-buying and illegal funding of political parties. It asks the EU to keep sanctioning those involved, to support Moldova's defence and economy, and to help it join the EU. It also calls on Russia to withdraw its troops from Transnistria. The text is a statement of the Parliament's position, not a new law.

- The EU is asked to keep sanctioning people and groups behind Russian interference; this affects Moldova's election and its voters.
- The EU is asked to support Moldova's defence, economy and EU membership talks; this affects Moldova's government and citizens.
- Russia is asked to withdraw its troops from Transnistria; no date or deadline is set.
